Service 02

Scrap Metal Recycling

Industrial scrap, electronic waste, and mixed-metal lots often contain significant precious metal value that goes unrecognized. Our specialized separation and assay process ensures every gram of gold, silver, and platinum group metals is recovered and accurately valued.

Pricing Basis

Verified metal content by weight

Turnaround

1–3 business days

Method

Pickup

Our Process

1

Drop Off or Pickup

Bring your scrap to our facility, or arrange secure pickup for commercial quantities over 5kg.

2

Sorting & Weighing

Our technicians separate materials by metal type and weigh each category on calibrated equipment.

3

Purity Testing

Mixed and uncertain lots undergo XRF analysis and, where needed, fire assay to determine exact precious metal content.

You receive a detailed breakdown of recovered metals and their value. Payment follows your approval.

Upgrade raw metal to certified investment grade

Service 03

Refining & Smelting

Our refining service transforms karat gold, silver alloys, and industrial scrap into 99.9%+ pure bullion. Using professional smelting furnaces and chemical refining (aqua regia for gold, electrolytic for silver), we produce certified bars suitable for investment, resale, or industrial use. Every batch is assayed and accompanied by a purity certificate.

Output Purity

99.9% — 99.99% (fine gold)

Turnaround

2–5 business days

Method

Aqua regia / electrolytic refining

Certification

Assay certificate per batch

Our Process

1

Material Submission

Submit your raw material for initial analysis. We determine the most efficient refining method based on composition.

2

Smelting

Material is melted in a controlled-temperature furnace to homogenize the alloy and remove base impurities.

3

Chemical Refining

Depending on the metal, we apply aqua regia (gold) or electrolytic processing (silver) to achieve 99.9%+ purity.

4

Assay & Certification

The refined bar is assayed for final purity. You receive a certificate and the finished bar, or account credit.

We Accept

Karat gold (9K–24K)Silver alloys & scrapIndustrial precious metal wasteDoré barsRefinery sweeps & dustPlatinum group metals (by inquiry)

XRF, ICP & Auto-Titration — lab-grade accuracy

Service 04

Purity Analysis & Testing

We determine the exact elemental composition and purity of your gold, silver, and other precious metal items using three complementary methods, each selected to match the material and the purity required: X-ray fluorescence (XRF) spectrometry for fast, non-destructive screening; inductively coupled plasma (ICP) analysis for trace-level and high-precision quantification of all elements; and auto-titration for precise determination of gold content in refined bullion. Our equipment is accurate to ±0.05% for gold content and provides a full breakdown of all alloying metals. Ideal for estate valuations, pre-purchase verification, dispute resolution, and batch certification.

Accuracy

±0.05% for gold content

Turnaround

5–10 minutes per item

Method

XRF + ICP + Auto-Titration

Output

Detailed composition report

Our Process

1

Submit Item

Bring your item to our office. No appointment required for standard testing.

2

XRF Scan

The item is placed in the XRF spectrometer. A full elemental scan takes 5–10 minutes and leaves no mark or damage.

3

Composition Report

You receive a printed report showing the percentage of gold, silver, copper, and other elements present.

4

Optional Acid Test

For additional confirmation, we can perform a traditional acid (touchstone) test at no extra charge.

We Accept

Gold jewelry & bullionSilver items & flatwareMixed or unknown alloysAntique & heirloom piecesEstate jewelry lotsCoins & numismatic items

Frequently asked questions

Answers about our services, testing, pricing and payment.

Who runs PMG Global?

PMG Global Company Limited is a family precious metals business in Bangkok, founded in 2016. It is led by Mr. Teerapat Tewarueangsap, Managing Director, with Ms. Thansinee Tewarueangsap as Head of Refining.

How long has PMG Global been operating?

Since 2016. In 2018 we added professional refining and smelting. In 2020 we obtained our precious metals dealer licence. In 2022 we invested in XRF spectrometry for purity analysis, and in 2024 we launched digital price tracking and online quotation services.

How much business have you done?

We have served more than 1,700 clients and refined 672,000 kg of metal.

Are you licensed?

Yes. We hold a Ministry of Commerce precious metals dealer licence and a scrap licence, and we operate under Thai regulations.

How do you test purity?

Every item is tested with XRF spectrometry. A scan takes 5–10 minutes, leaves no mark, and is accurate to ±0.05% for gold content. For high-precision work we also use ICP analysis and auto-titration, and we can add an acid (touchstone) test at no extra charge. You can watch the whole process.

How is my price calculated, and what is the spread?

Gold and silver prices follow the live international spot price and the USD/THB rate, converted to baht per kg or per baht-weight (15.244 g). The prices shown on this website are flat estimates with no spread. In an actual quote, our buying price sits slightly below, and our selling price slightly above, that spot-based figure; the difference is our spread. You see the spot price, the exchange rate, the weight and the purity before you agree to anything, and the final quote is confirmed at our office after XRF testing.

How and when do I get paid?

Once you accept the quote you are paid the same day, by bank transfer or cash. There is no waiting period.

What do you buy?

Gold and silver in any form: jewellery of any karat, bars and coins, dental gold, watches and accessories, broken or damaged jewellery, and industrial or electronic scrap that contains precious metals.

Can you refine my gold or silver?

Yes. We refine karat gold, silver alloys and industrial scrap to 99.9%–99.99% purity, using aqua regia for gold and electrolytic refining for silver. Refining takes 2–5 business days and every batch comes with an assay certificate.

Do I need an appointment?

No appointment is needed for standard quantities or standard testing. For commercial scrap over 5 kg we can arrange a secure pickup.

Where are you and when are you open?

We are in Bangkok and open Monday to Saturday, 9:00 to 17:30, and on Sundays by appointment. Call 087-085-8228 or 095-635-1788, or message us on LINE. Our full street address will be added soon.

Where can I see your policies?

Our compliance policies are listed on the Compliance page. If you need a copy or have an audit question, please contact us.

Still have a question?

Call us and we will help right away.
